edbDesc: A self-feeding and potentially destructive vibration where aerodynamic forces on an object couple with a structure's natural mode of vibration to produce rapid periodic motion. Flutter can occur in any object within a strong fluid flow, under the conditions that a positive feedback occurs between the structure's natural vibration and the aerodynamic forces.
title: Aeroelastic Flutter
pickWhy: A variant of Flutter, which is in another batch and is the broader common name; I did not make a card here.
